title: Task management app — teams, boards, due dates

define.note: Approved by the user at the gate on 2026-09-03, after being shown the no-password-reset risk and the polling-vs-push resolution. Fresh-eyes pass fixed 6 defects before presentation (SC5 auth-leak ambiguity, SC10 flaky timing window, SC11 unprovable claim, unspecified session lifetime, no leave-team path, silent column-delete cascade).

design.note: UI intake per define Step 1b — no mockups supplied; direction distilled from Q16.

harden.note: SCHEDULED, not optional: self-hosted email+password auth is a security-sensitive surface (hashing, session fixation, login brute-force, and the member-lookup enumeration oracle in SC7). Must run before any release.

open_items_for_resume: Git isolation is unresolved: the repo has ZERO commits, so master is an unborn ref and there was nothing to branch from. Establish a baseline commit on a main branch before creating task/0001-task-management-mvp.
I5 (dense integer ordering) is deferred to blueprint by design — the spec commits to stable explicit ordering, not to an encoding of it.
No password reset exists. Flagged as the largest MVP product risk, accepted knowingly.
halt_reason: User instruction: stop after the spec gate. Gate passed; run ended cleanly here.
